<subject>Re: Monkey Business</subject>
<body>
I'm an expert at being a rabid fan and excellent arm chair manager.  I keep 
waiting for the Kalgoorlie site to call for advice....





"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:28:25 PM
To: <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:  

Subject: Re: Monkey Business

Sorry for the late notice - have been swamped this week trying to get 
the Pilbara rail contract and the Port upgrades finalised, and just 
realized today that I needed to get on this.  Will hope to see you there 
and try to find another time we can go.  My understanding from all is 
that you are the resident cricket expert (next to Robert Stanley).

Best regards.

cgt
</body>
<quoted>
>>> <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au> 29/03/24 04:12PM >>>

I would love to take you up on it, but I'm already lined up to go.  I'll
take a raincheck!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Adam




"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:07:45 PM

To:   <margaret.cox@tasmanridge.com.au>, <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>,
      <eric.moore@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:

Subject:  Monkey Business

My recollection is that each of you is somewhat of a cricket fan, as I am.
I just happen to have 4 great seats for the season opener at Tasman Ridge 
Oval, for which I very much need company to help me enjoy.  I would love it 
if each of you could join me.  The match starts at 4:05 pm, so it might 
require leaving the office a little early.  But of course we would be 
discussing serious business the entire time so that it would be fully 
justifiable to anyone interested.  I will bring my legal pad to take notes.

Let me know.  Hope you can come.

cgt
